searchUrls.title: Zillow search URLs
searchUrls.description: Full Zillow search URLs. Example: https://www.zillow.com/homes/Austin-TX_rb/ for Austin for-sale, or a filtered map search pasted from zillow.com.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: City and state like "Austin, TX" or zip codes. Used when searchUrls is blank.

listingType.title: Listing type
listingType.description: for_sale, for_rent, or sold. Default for_sale.

propertyTypes.title: Property types
propertyTypes.description: Keep only matching types: house, condo, townhouse, apartment, manufactured, multifamily, lot, other. Empty keeps all.

maxPages.title: Max pages per search
maxPages.description: Zillow returns up to 40 listings per page. 5 pages = 200 listings. Cap to control cost.

maxItemsPerSource.title: Max items per source
maxItemsPerSource.description: Per search cap on rows pushed.

maxItemsTotal.title: Max items per run
maxItemsTotal.description: Hard cap on rows per run. Controls total cost.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip zpids pushed on previous runs. Turn off to track price changes over time.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential strongly recommended. Zillow blocks datacenter IPs aggressively.
